title: Electric Supercar Review Thumbnail
summary: This prompt generates a YouTube thumbnail for an electric supercar review, showing the car from a dramatic angle with a blurred city background and a "mind-blown" YouTuber. It aims for a sleek, modern feel.
prompt: A thumbnail for a review of a new electric supercar. The car is shown from a low, dramatic angle, making it look powerful and aggressive. The headlights are on, and the background is a blurred motion shot of a city at night. The YouTuber is standing next to the car with a wide-eyed, “mind-blown” expression. The text “The Future is HERE!” is in a sleek, modern font. –ar 16:9
